name: app-frontend
description: Frontend JS deps. Run `pnpm install` (postinstall auto-runs vendor) to copy assets into assets/vendor.

scripts.vendor: mkdir -p assets/vendor && cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.js assets/vendor/chart.umd.js && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css assets/vendor/bootstrap.min.css && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js assets/vendor/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
